Priya (CS): Alder Diagnostics needs a short pilot window in APAC — requesting regional allowlist + temporary QPS bump for onboarding (May 3-5). CIDRs: 34.120.50.0/24, 34.120.51.0/24. Target region: ap-northeast-1. Requesting 800 qps, auto-revoke 72h after end. Can ops approve?
Jon R (Enablement): Ok — flagging renewal watch here, their renewal is in ~2 months. If pilot goes sideways with cost/latency we need to loop sales.
Theo (Ops): Need exact start/end times + confirmation those CIDRs belong to their prod edge. Also we require an internal ticket and cost tag.
Priya (CS): Start 2025-05-03 00:00 UTC -> end 2025-05-05 23:59 UTC. CIDRs came from their networking team — I verified with their engineer Keiko. I'll open the ticket now.
Sasha (SRE): We should add a temporary alert for tail-latency and token spend for that project id. Also whitelist only the CIDRs, not the whole ASN.
Theo (Ops): I can provision the allowlist and bump, but need the ticket number and an owner for post-pilot rollback. Can we do auto-revoke at 2025-05-09 23:59 UTC?
Priya (CS): Yes auto-revoke 2025-05-09 23:59 UTC works. I'll be the rollback owner and will confirm when pilot finishes.
Theo (Ops): Creating temp rule. Example API we will call: 
```
POST /v1/allowlists
{
  "customer": "alder-diagnostics",
  "region": "ap-northeast-1",
  "cidrs": ["34.120.50.0/24","34.120.51.0/24"],
  "qps": 800,
  "auto_revoke": "2025-05-09T23:59:00Z",
  "note": "CS pilot - Priya"
}
```
Theo (Ops): Ticket created: CS-4527. Adding cost-center tag: cs_pilot_alder. Will apply rule after compliance signoff.
Sasha (SRE): Compliance done, minimal PII exposure. I'll add dashboards and an on-call pager for the pilot.
deploy-bot: config change queued -> CS-4527 -> applying allowlist + qps bump in ap-northeast-1 now.
deploy-bot: config change applied :white_check_mark: (rule id: rule-als-20250503-01)
Theo (Ops): Done. Auto-revoke scheduled and will generate a rollback PR that will run at the scheduled time. Please confirm any test traffic so we can warm KV caches.
Priya (CS): Sending test flight from Keiko in 10m, will post logs here. Thanks all.
Jon R (Enablement): Capture pilot feedback re: latency and billing impact — we'll include summary in renewal health doc.
Priya (CS): Will do, adding notes to CS healthboard and tagging renewal risk. Thanks everyone :pray:
